name: QuickPay
summary: A wallet and bills app. I audited 105 inconsistent screens and rebuilt them as 91 on one design system.
tldr: QuickPay hired me to redesign its wallet and bills app. I audited 105 inconsistent screens, built a design system with 120+ tokens in light and dark, rebuilt the app as 91 screens, and prototyped the Send money flow in code.

caseStudy.result: 91 screens on 120+ tokens, with dark mode and a 4-flow prototype
